description: 4-stage NAP curriculum: NAP=1→2→4→8 with bs=2→4→8→16. Top-down anchor tree built from target NAP=8 architecture. Between stages: additive merge formula parent[bits_A, bits_B] = child_A[bits_A] + child_B[bits_B]. Equal step count per stage (option B): 4000 steps each → 16000 total, 120K bs-units (~93% of exp365). Curriculum applies to all 4 LUT modules. Target architecture matches exp365's tph values but unified NAP=8 (vs exp365's qkv/residual at NAP=6).
